messages.author: 665b3d97beb30882
messages.subject: Re: BioGeoBEARS Replacement ERROR
parts:
Hi, if I didn't reply before,

1. The master_table thing is for time-stratified analysis, otherwise ignore it - it's a table containing all of the pieces of the tree after it's been time-sliced

2. The BayArea+j problem seems to happen sometimes on PCs, it's probably some difference in precision, usually the solution is to narrow the limits on d,e, and j. I'll try running it when I get a chance.

Cheers!
Nick
